name: Remembered Blow
description: Strike with the exact force and angle remembered from the one blow that ever got through this foe's guard.

name: Recall Brace
description: Brace in the exact way that held the last time the same kind of blow fell.

name: Detail Sweep
description: Sweep the eyes across a scene once and fix every object and face in it as clear as a painting.

name: Anchored Stride
description: Anchor a route in the mind and move along it at a run without checking a single turn.

name: Reminder Touch
description: Touch an ally and put back into the ally's hands the form the ally learned and lost in the shock of the fight.

name: Forgetting Mist
description: Breathe out a mist that makes the foes who enter it forget why they came.

name: Dispelled Fog
description: Dispel the fog of a memory-clouding curse from an ally and return the lost hours to clear light.

name: Piercing Recall
description: Drive a spike of the foe's own worst remembered moment through the guard of the mind.

name: Perfect Retention
description: Give an ally for a long moment the power to keep and repeat every motion seen without loss.

name: Residual Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries the residue of every strike once thrown at this spot.

name: Tread Memory
description: Draw on the ground's memory of heavy tread to root the stance as firmly as old paving.

name: Place Reading
description: Read the memory a place keeps of those who stood in it last and learn how many and how long ago.

name: Elder Step
description: Step into the footprints remembered by the ground and move as lightly as the first to tread there.

name: Past Voice
description: Call an echo of an ally's own past triumph to the ally's ear so the ally remembers what the ally can do.

name: Scene Replay
description: Replay in the mind the last events at a spot so each actor in them is seen at once.

name: Projected Past
description: Project a remembered scene round a foe so the foe fights shadows of what once happened here.

name: Recalled Lance
description: Hurl a lance made from the memory of every spear once thrown through this place.

name: Hour Shroud
description: Wrap the user in the memory of an earlier hour so the foe strikes at a place the user no longer stands.

name: Resurgent Past
description: Let the whole remembered violence of a place rise at once and strike every foe standing in it.

name: Drill Recall
description: Call to mind the rank's shared drill so that all in earshot fall into the same motion.

name: Drilled Fist
description: Throw a fist in the order's drilled form that has been repeated ten thousand times.

name: Muster Count
description: Count the comrades present and remember who stood where when the fight began.

name: Ordered Guard
description: Take the guard that the order drilled for this blow and hold it without a thought.

name: Standing Orders
description: Call back the standing orders in the voice of the commander so each comrade acts on them as one.

name: Drilled Counter
description: Meet a familiar attack with the order's drilled counter and break the attacker's flow.

name: Order's Memory
description: Hold the memory of a whole company's drill in the user's head and let every member draw on it.

name: Drilled Surge
description: Surge out of the line with a blow in which every comrade's drill is felt.

name: Record Fist
description: Hit with a fist that remembers the cold clean line of the best strike it ever threw.

name: Sapphire Guard
description: Hold a guard that remembers its own shape and cannot be knocked out of it.

name: Record Sense
description: Open a clear record of the moment in the mind and mark every detail in it.

name: Record Step
description: Move along a step-by-step record of a past dodge and repeat it flawlessly.

name: Record Word
description: Speak a line from the record and let an ally take the lesson in it at once.

name: Pale Blur
description: Cast a pale blur over a foe's memory of where the user stood a heartbeat ago.

name: Record Replay
description: Replay a kept record at the pace of a single breath to catch the one thing missed the first time.

name: Record Mending
description: Mend the gaps in an ally's memory with the user's own clear record of the same hours.

name: Sapphire Haze
description: Spread a soft blue haze over the field in which no foe can hold a clear picture of the user's side.

name: Sapphire Seal
description: Seal a technique into the foe's forgetting so the foe cannot recall how to use it for a time.

name: Clear Record
description: Hold the true record of events so firmly in mind that a false memory pressed on it cannot take.

name: Pledge Recall
description: Remind an ally of the pledge the ally gave and let the memory of it straighten the ally's back.

name: Pledge Fist
description: Strike with a fist that remembers what a broken pledge cost.

name: Pledge Count
description: Count the pledges a person has made and measure which of them are still being kept.

name: Troth Guard
description: Hold a guard backed by the memory of a pledge kept under fire.

name: Pledge Reminder
description: Speak the pledge aloud and steady the whole line with the memory of what was sworn.

name: Breaker's Blur
description: Blur a pledge-breaker's memory of the oath so the breaker hesitates over what is owed.

name: Pledge Cleansing
description: Cleanse a binding that came of a coerced pledge from an ally by calling the true memory of the coercion.

name: Pledge Seal
description: Seal the breaker of a pledge so that the breaker's technique channels shut at the moment of the lie.

name: Pledge Remembered
description: Hold the memory of a pledge in the user's mind and lend its strength to every ally who shares it.

name: Chronicle Fist
description: Hit with a fist that carries a written record of every past blow struck in the same fight.

name: Chronicle Guard
description: Raise a guard from the chronicle of blows already taken and turned.

name: Chronicle Sense
description: Note each event of a fight as it happens so the whole can be read in order afterwards.

name: Chronicle Step
description: Move to the place that the chronicle says the next blow will fall away from.

name: Chronicle Word
description: Read out a line of the chronicle that tells an ally exactly what to do next.

name: Storm Replay
description: Replay the storm of the last minute at an even pace to find the one move that decided it.

name: Chronicle Mending
description: Mend a stormed and scattered memory in an ally by setting its events back in their order.

name: Storm Blur
description: Loose a blur of too many events at once so the foe cannot tell which of them is real.

name: Written Storm
description: Cast the whole written chronicle of a storm back over the field in one wave of recalled blows.

name: Chronicle Ward
description: Hold the chronicle of the fight so firmly that a technique built on a false account of it fails.
